title: Learning effectiveness plan: Synthetic pump fire, 2024
audience: HSE lead, safety committee and function managers
status: Learning purposes: not a statutory document

bottom_line.text: The plan sets 11 checks for 3 learnings, each counted from the day the organisation adopts the learning; the priority-1 seal learning is checked five times in its first 12 months.
The seal and alarm learnings reach the whole organisation at system depth; the drill learning stays at site level and changes a procedure.

sections.heading: Who sets owners, dates and statuses

items.text: The organisation sets owners, dates and statuses. This plan sets out what to check and when, counted from adoption.

rows: Share of pump seals bought against an approved specification
Seal leaks on the unit's pumps (count per year)
Share of gas alarms with a defined and tested automatic response
Gas releases that reach the alarm level before an isolation (count per year)
Share of fire drills with a recorded observation and action
Drill actions still open at the next drill (count)

items.question: What would an auditor see that shows LR-01 is applied?
items.why: An auditor checks that the learning is applied, by what they can see or hear, not by what is written.
items.good_evidence: An approved specification for each pump seal in stores, and seals in a sample matching it.

items.question: What would an auditor see that shows LR-02 is applied?
items.why: An auditor checks that the learning is applied, by what they can see or hear, not by what is written.
items.good_evidence: A cause-and-effect chart that links each gas alarm to its shutdown, and a recent test record.

items.question: What would an auditor see that shows LR-03 is applied?
items.why: An auditor checks that the learning is applied, by what they can see or hear, not by what is written.
items.good_evidence: Drill records that list observations and actions, and the actions closed by the next drill.

items.text: The organisation records each check in its own verification log, made with PMLC templates <ws> verification: the check date, the level reached, the evidence seen and the role that assessed it. Statuses come only from the organisation; this plan never records one.
